Summary: The sources indicate that the accuracy of a BM25 retriever for finding all supporting evidence for a question on the HOTPOTQA training dataset decreases from 53.7% to 25.9% on the 'easy' and 'hard' subsets. The BM25 retrieval performance is also compared against other models, showing that it achieves an F1 score of 0.6166 with sentence-level retrieval, while paragraph and token retrieval raise all-supporting-fact recovery to approximately 87–88% with F1 near 0.67. The baseline model of Yang et al. (2018) achieved an EM of 53.7% and an F1 of 3.86 on HotpotQA.
